name: METR Time Horizons
measures: Length of task a model completes half the time
about: METR measures how long a task, timed in human working hours, an AI model can complete with a 50% success rate. We keep only these estimates, not its files, to calculate a score and quote the highest one.
attribution: Figure quoted from METR Time Horizons.
limitations: The newest estimates have wide ranges, and METR has said they depend heavily on modelling assumptions.
METR did not measure every model, and measured some long after release.
